description: This is a C# source file defining classes, interfaces, and attributes related to grain interface properties within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes a class for storing interface properties, constants for well-known property keys, and attributes for configuring grain interface behavior.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceProperties
classes.description: Immutable class representing properties of a grain interface, including a method to produce a detailed string representation.

classes.name: WellKnownGrainInterfaceProperties
classes.description: Static class defining constant keys for standard grain interface properties such as version, default grain type, and type name.

classes.name: IGrainInterfacePropertiesProvider
classes.description: Interface for classes that add grain interface properties based on interface type and grain type.

classes.name: IGrainInterfacePropertiesProviderAttribute
classes.description: Interface for attributes that add grain interface properties, typically to support attribute-driven configuration.

classes.name: AttributeGrainInterfacePropertiesProvider
classes.description: Implementation of IGrainInterfacePropertiesProvider that populates properties based on attributes applied to interfaces.

classes.name: DefaultGrainTypeAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to specify the default grain type for a grain interface, implementing the properties provider interface.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceProperties
methods.description: Constructor initializing the interface properties dictionary.

methods.name: ToDetailedString
methods.description: Produces a detailed string representation of the properties contained in the instance.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Method in IGrainInterfacePropertiesProvider to populate properties based on interface type and grain type.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Method in IGrainInterfacePropertiesProviderAttribute to add properties based on attribute configuration.
